definitions.gloss: beginning of the month; start of the month
definitions.explanation: The first few days of a calendar month. Used when referring to events, deadlines, or schedules at the start of a month.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{初|はじ}めに{会議|かいぎ}がある。
examples.english: There's a meeting at the beginning of the month.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}は{毎月|まいつき}{月|つき}{初|はじ}めに{払|はら}います。
examples.english: I pay rent at the beginning of each month.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{初|はじ}めから{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトが{始|はじ}まるので、{準備|じゅんび}しておいてください。
examples.english: A new project starts at the beginning of the month, so please prepare.

notes:
{月|つき}{初|はじ}め refers to the first few days of a calendar month, typically the first through fifth.

USAGE:
Often used with particles に or から when specifying timing: {月|つき}{初|はじ}めに (at the beginning of the month), {月|つき}{初|はじ}めから (from the beginning of the month).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|つき}{初|はじ}めに{届|とど}く: to arrive at the beginning of the month
- {月|つき}{初|はじ}めに{払|はら}う: to pay at the beginning of the month
- {来月|らいげつ}の{月|つき}{初|はじ}め: the beginning of next month

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {月|つき}{末|すえ}: end of the month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば: middle of the month
- {月頭|げっとう}: beginning of the month (more formal, business-oriented)
- {上旬|じょうじゅん}: first third of the month (days 1-10)
